data.one_liner: A virtual keyboard widget with multi-language support and custom layouts.
data.what_it_does: Provides a customizable virtual keyboard widget suitable for devices like kiosks and ATMs. It supports multiple languages (such as English, Arabic, and Kurdish) and numeric or alphanumeric input types without native code dependencies.
use_when: You are building apps for touchscreens, kiosks, or ATMs.
You need an on-screen virtual keyboard with multi-language support.
avoid_when: You only need standard device system keyboards.
You need complex built-in popup floating keyboard behaviours out-of-the-box (marked as TODO in docs).
strengths: No native code dependencies, pure Dart implementation.
weaknesses: Some features like popup floating keyboards and input result viewers are marked as TODO in the documentation.
Limited to the layout features provided by the package.
data.minimal_example:
Container(
  color: Colors.deepPurple,
  child: VirtualKeyboard(
    height: 350,
    width: 600,
    textColor: Colors.white,
    fontSize: 20,
    type: VirtualKeyboardType.Alphanumeric,
    postKeyPress: (key) => print(key.text),
  ),
)
